title: 能力市场：DBA 能否设计出可扩展的数据模型（v3 db-spec 为基线）
task: stage: dba. Design the data model for this change: 02-shape/db-spec.md and 02-shape/schema.dbml (inputs: briefing, spec, contract). The briefing's Fog / out-of-scope list and the spec's out-of-scope section are the known roadmap.
v3_gaps_observed: grep on baseline db-spec.md (2026-09-17): 压力测试 0 · 上下文 0 · 扩展 0 · Next/下一轮/未来 0 matches
The model is an increment of columns on capability_assets (migration 050 spec); deferred roadmap items (remote sources, public install counts, official detail page) are not walked through the model
what_good_looks_like: The change placed in a domain model (contexts, aggregates, invariants, one vocabulary), a roadmap stress test over the deferred items showing additive changes or accepted costs with triggers, extension points justified by known variation (asset kinds, versions, tenant-private assets) with the cost of adding a variant, and correctness backed by constraints and evidence.

rubric.criterion: Places the change in a domain model: contexts, aggregates, invariants, ubiquitous language
Walks known roadmap items through the model; additive or cost accepted with a trigger
Extension points justified by known variation, with the cost of adding a variant
Grain sentences, constraints for uniqueness and invariants, snapshot vs reference, state transitions
Indexes derived from access patterns with evidence or clearly labelled presumptions
